title: The Paraparticle–PEFF Cross-Scale Rhyme

workingForm.question: Do internal PEFF organizational patterns recur across cognitive dynamics, particle events, and paraparticle quantum statistics, and can independently demonstrated mechanisms be wired into a larger FractiSI systemic proof?
workingForm.answerBounded: Yes — as a scientifically testable cross-domain organizational rhyme and a constructible Wiring Wet Lab chain. Not as a new force or physical identity claim.
workingForm.rhyme: State → Internal Organization → Relational Transformation → Observable Signature
workingForm.wiring: neural organization → oscillatory/phase organization → physical transformation → exchange/interference → non-classical statistics
workingForm.compact: Different systems. Same organizational rhyme under test.

doesNotProve: PEFF as a new fundamental force
universal equivalence of spin, phase, and polarity
a single physical mechanism connecting EEG and quantum statistics
discovery of a new elementary particle outside the cited quantum simulation
